nodes.text: The minister finishes. People disperse into their own quiet griefs.
The small wood at the edge of the cemetery catches the afternoon light in a way that makes it look like something is moving through it, just out of sight.
Come to the reception? There's enough food for three funerals.
She says it lightly. She has already decided not to mention the house again, and you can see the decision costing her.
She says it lightly. Not thinking about it yet is, she has decided, the same as thinking about it; she will wait with you.
She says it lightly. Someone in it, she had said — and she is looking at you the way you look at a house you might move back into.
[beat:still]A small mercy. A small wood. Small volumes of everything.
